answer: A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, locking 61 POA that is slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. The dawn of the register names the voucher for every alias, so a farm's whole sponsor ladder is visible at once; the marble of a conviction climbs the chain, and the sparrow of slashed bonds pays the auditors who caught it. No honest sponsor risks real money on a stranger, so 715 fakes need 715 bought sponsors.
